title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: competitiveAnalysis

competitive analysis
competitive analysis
(definition)
Definition:
An analysis in which the performance of an
on-line algorithm
is compared to the best that could have been achieved if all the inputs had been known in advance.
Note:
From Algorithms and Theory of Computation Handbook, page 10-17, Copyright © 1999 by CRC Press LLC. Appearing in the Dictionary of Computer Science, Engineering and Technology, Copyright © 2000 CRC Press LLC.
